messages:
alex: heads-up — post-deploy checks for release/edge-payment just surfaced a values schema error in the canary cluster :eyes:

maria: saw the alert too. deploy-bot posted: "preflight: values.schemaValidation failed: missing required key 'db.replicaCount'"

deploy-bot: [automated] deploy blocked on release/edge-payment v2026.03.10. chart=payments-helm v2.4.0. Reason=values.schemaValidation. Suggested action=pin to last-known-good or fix values.

jamal: do we know if this was a values template change in the chart or a strict schema upgrade?

maria: chart bumped the values.schema in 2.4.0 — it now requires db.replicaCount and storageClass. previous releases worked with defaults.

alex: options: 1) patch our values to include the new required keys and re-run canary, 2) pin chart to 2.3.1 and continue rollout now, 3) rollback canary and schedule a hotfix during change window.

sophia: constraint: we have a paid demo scheduled in 35m. if we pin to 2.3.1 we keep behavior identical to prod. prefer pin + postmortem. :thumbsup:

jamal: agreed. pin feels lowest-risk for customer-facing demo. who can cut the pin?

maria: i can do it. i'll update the helmrelease to chartVersion: 2.3.1 and trigger deploy-bot pin command.

alex: write the commands you plan to run in thread so oncall can audit.

maria: running:
```bash
# pin the chart to previous version and patch values if needed
kubectl -n payments patch helmrelease edge-payment --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/chart/version","value":"2.3.1"}]'
# verify dry-run
helm upgrade --install edge-payment ./chart --version 2.3.1 --namespace payments --dry-run
```

deploy-bot: [automated] detected manual patch to HelmRelease edge-payment by maria. Validating and scheduling apply.

eng-release-oncall: heads-up: if deploy-bot succeeds, keep an eye on metrics for the next 10m (p95 latency + error rate). we'll postpone database-related changes until we've handled schema compatibility.

jamal: alex, can you own release notes update? needs a short blurb: why we pinned, next steps to move to 2.4.0, and who's owning the values change.

alex: on it. drafting: "Pin payments-helm to 2.3.1 in release/edge-payment to avoid new required values introduced in 2.4.0. Reason: keep demo stability. Follow up: eng/infra to add missing values and test in staging; target re-roll to 2.4.0 after validation. Owner: maria + jamal."

maria: deploy-bot completed apply, canary deploy started. logs show helm post-render ok.

deploy-bot: [automated] canary phase: completed (3/3 replicas healthy). No new errors observed.

sophia: great, demo green. please add a short postmortem note with the commit/PR that introduced the stricter schema.

jamal: created PR #4821 to add required values to our values.yaml and test harness. tagging infra.

alex: thanks. follow-up plan: 1) infra to run e2e with 2.4.0 in staging (maria), 2) once green, schedule a controlled rollout outside demo window and update notes (jamal).

maria: marking this thread resolved for now. leaving rollback option open if we see any regressions in next 15m.

eng-release-oncall: noted. will escalate if p95 latency > 300ms or error rate > 0.5% for payments service.

sophia: :tada: thanks everyone.
